drafts.headline: GPT-6 Preview Lands with a Jump on ARC-AGI
drafts.subhead: OpenAI's preview posts multi-step reasoning gains; an arXiv preprint corroborates.
drafts.body_md:
OpenAI released a preview of **GPT-6** today with new results on ARC-AGI, and the community response is fast. The [Hacker News thread](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42101) pulled 428 points in under a day. An arXiv preprint on the same preview arrived within hours — evidence that this isn't a solo announcement pass but a topic with independent uptake.

What's notable is the *cross-source corroboration*: a company blog, a discussion thread, and a research writeup all pointing at the same artifact within one lookback window.
key_signals: corroborated by an arXiv preprint on the same day
